blocks.html: When it comes to Filipino consumer culture, it is always foremost to shop for a bargain, such that there is no other destination that excites the Pinoy shopper more than her beloved ‘tiangge’. But with all congested roads leading to an equally-bustling bargain center, more often than not, the penny-pinching Pinoy shopper has to contend with stress just to have a few savings. Fortunately, one key development in the Metro is shaping up to welcome our thrift shopping frenzy, offering the clever consumers more room for practical retail selections.

The pioneering shopping center at the heart of Quezon City’s most dynamic growth district, Robinsons Novaliches recently unveiled an additional 10,500 square-meter of prime retail space, perfect for small and medium retail businesses that are keen on cashing in on bargain shopping. Yet, unlike its hectic and hard-to-reach counterparts, Robinsons Novaliches brings all the conveniences and of a modern mall right at the north.

Anchored by the area’s most strategic and organized public transport terminal, Robinsons Novaliches serves as the gateway for the residents of the nearby communities of Novaliches and Fairview in Quezon City, as well as the cities of Caloocan and Valenzuela, and the progressive town of San Jose del Monte in Bulacan. In line with the revitalized MMDA Bus Route Scheme, Robinsons Novaliches Public Transport Terminal, serves as the hub for straight-line buses that services key points in Metro Manila, making it a highly convenient stop.

For mall-goers aboard their own cars, the new Robinsons Novaliches also has 1,100 vehicle parking slots that provide easy, sweat-free access to the multi-level mall.
Rewarding Business Activity

With a population of more than 2.5 million people in its immediate vicinity, Robinsons Novaliches’ offers a retail destination that takes advantage of the thriving economic potential of the area. Its wide, airy layout furnished with central escalators and well-lit common spaces make the new Robinsons Novaliches a welcoming retail destination for young and old alike, as well as families opting for a respite from the usual high-priced malls.

Robinsons Novaliches will house over 300 micro retail outlets of a wide variety of trade, organized in spacious, well-ventilated, and intelligently-lit shopping zones. The first level will see a wide variety of home furnishing brands, decors, novelty and gift items, as well as toys, while the second level will be home to apparels, shoes, bags, and accessories.

And since Robinsons Novaliches serves as an integral commercial landmark in the area, the new mall also features a 1,200 sqm spacious Trade Hall that will have seasonal exhibits, as well as serve as a convenient venue for events and entertainment offerings.

With all the best features that come with your favorite Robinsons Mall but now with a firmer focus on value-for-money retail and trade, Robinsons Novaliches is shaping the way people shop, and live, up in the North.
